name.value: Van Isle Cowichan RV Park & Campground

description.value: Van Isle Cowichan RV Park & Campground is an 11-acre riverside campground nestled along the Cowichan River just off the Trans-Canada Highway near Duncan, under new ownership and rebranding. It offers a mix of full-service RV sites, partial-service sites, and tent sites on Vancouver Island in one of Canada's warmest climates. Touring cyclists can access the campground as a base for river tubing, trail hiking, and exploring the Cowichan Valley wine region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the business is operating under new ownership at 2950 Boys Road, Duncan, BC, alongside the Cowichan River. The site explicitly lists 8 tent sites for daily/weekly stays, and states onsite washrooms and showers exist but are 'reserved for seasonal campers registered on our Partial-Service & Tent Sites.' A nearby services passage explicitly names grocery store, laundromat, coffee shops, and restaurants within minutes of Duncan city centre.
